title: Ethical Reasoning & Integrity
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Recognise the moral stakes in how knowledge is produced and used — plagiarism, bias, authorship, consent.

steps.title: Spot the ethical stake
steps.text: Notice where a choice has a moral dimension, not just a technical one.

steps.title: Name who is affected
steps.text: Identify the people and groups your decision touches, including the unseen ones.

steps.title: Weigh the principles
steps.text: Balance honesty, fairness, harm and respect — say which pull against each other here.

steps.title: Check your integrity
steps.text: Attribute every source, declare bias and funding, and never present others’ work as your own.

steps.title: Decide and justify
steps.text: Make the call and be able to defend it openly — transparency is the test.

feedForward.text: Take one decision in your work (a source, a method, an authorship) and write the one-line justification you could defend in public.
